Vulnerabilities.Title: Command injection in lodash's template function
Vulnerabilities.Description: Sample finding. lodash before 4.17.21 lets the variable option of its template function run commands.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Slow regular expression in lodash's toNumber and trim
Vulnerabilities.Description: Sample finding. A long crafted string makes these lodash functions very slow.

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Access block should block public ACL
Misconfigurations.Description: Sample finding. A bucket without this block accepts objects with a public ACL.
Misconfigurations.Message: No public access block so not blocking public acls
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable blocking any PUT calls with a public ACL specified
